div.style: line-height: 170%;

li.font: Pop the top index (idx) from the stack.

Since temperatures[i] > temperatures[stack.top()],
temperatures[i] is the next warmer day for temperatures[idx]
So, set res[idx] = i - idx, as we waited i - idx days for a warmer day from idx.
